slots.section_title: Device Physics and Material Platforms for Scalable Photonic Computing Integration
slots.intended_reader_takeaway: Compare key material properties (electro-optic coefficient, propagation loss, nonlinear effects, CMOS compatibility, modulation speed, fabrication maturity) across silicon photonics, thin-film lithium niobate, indium phosphide, and silicon nitride platforms to make the fundamental trade-off landscape explicit for scalable photonic computing design choices.

slots.section_title: Photonic Matrix Multiplication Engines as Core Computational Units in Scalable Photonic Computing
slots.intended_reader_takeaway: Plot the precision-energy-throughput trade-off space positioning photonic MAC units against electronic counterparts (SRAM-based, DRAM-based, GPU tensor cores) to visually establish where photonic computation holds advantages and where it falls short, directly supporting the section's claim about fundamental constraints on algorithmic applicability.

slots.section_title: Scalability Bottlenecks in Scalable Photonic Computing: Loss Accumulation, Thermal Crosstalk, and Control Complexity
slots.intended_reader_takeaway: Show how cascaded insertion loss, thermal crosstalk errors, and electronic control overhead compound non-linearly as the number of tunable elements and mesh depth increase in programmable photonic circuits, making the compounding nature of scaling bottlenecks visually intuitive.

slots.section_title: Electronic-Photonic Co-Design Methodologies for Integrated Scalable Photonic Computing Systems
slots.intended_reader_takeaway: Present a layered co-design framework showing the optimization boundaries and information flow between AI algorithms, compilers, firmware calibration layers, and photonic-electronic hardware substrates, clarifying how co-design treats the entire stack as a unified optimization problem rather than optimizing components independently.

slots.section_title: Programmable Photonic Circuit Architectures and Reconfigurable Mesh Topologies for Photonic Computing
slots.intended_reader_takeaway: Show the hierarchical composition from basic MZI element to full mesh topology for photonic computing

slots.section_title: Photonic AI Acceleration within Scalable Photonic Computing Systems: Workload Mapping, Co-Design, and Performance Benchmarks
slots.intended_reader_takeaway: Present a workload-suitability map showing where photonic computing accelerators outperform, match, or lag behind electronic alternatives

slots.section_title: Optical Interconnect Fabrics for Distributed Scalable Photonic Computing Systems
slots.intended_reader_takeaway: Map interconnect technologies to scaling tiers with associated bandwidth, latency, and energy metrics for photonic computing
